license: BSD-2-Clause for the loader; included public XNU headers retain APSL-2.0.
implementation: Project implementation of a native 64-bit boot contract; a private-stack bridge calls the C collection installer, then XNU owns CPU initialization.

boot_contract.argument: SysV RDI points to the pinned XNU boot_args structure
boot_contract.execution: Long mode and paging remain enabled from UEFI through kernel startup.

build: Clang compiles a C translation unit and the private-stack bridge; GNU-EFI provides standard runtime objects and linking support; generated PE headers, sections and executable entry are checked.
